validation.notes: No official logo or brand mark exists for PEC-PG on any official page examined. Fetched official_source_url (MRE PEC-PG 2027 selection process, HTTP 200): every on it is an inline base64 data URI - a 1x1 tracking pixel and two 32x32 base64 icons for the Facebook/Twitter/LinkedIn/WhatsApp share buttons; there is no external image asset at all, and the page carries no programme logo. Same for the parent 'Study opportunities for international applicants' page, the Portuguese PEC-G section pages (/programas-de-estudo-para-estrangeiros/pec-g and /pec-g/sobre) and the linked CNPq Call No. 16/2026 page: zero non-data: image sources. The MRE institutional logomarca/brand-asset page (gov.br/mre/pt-br/centrais-de-conteudo/fotos-logomarcas-institucionais, which advertises 'Assinatura entre o MRE e Governo Federal' PNG/PDF downloads) renders as 'Conteudo Restrito - E necessario autenticar para visualizar essa pagina', so no MRE mark is publicly retrievable either, and an MRE/Itamaraty institutional signature is not the PEC-PG programme identity in any case. Federal Government brand manuals on gov.br are for other organs (Ministério da Defesa, IEC, PR Secretaria de Comunicacao) and would be an identity mismatch. The Brazilian national coat of arms is a state symbol, not a programme logo. Per the brief, image_url stays null: official absence beats invented branding.
